acceptance_criteria: The shared PDP renders Morning Defense System and Evening Defense System cards immediately after the main purchase area and before Judge.me reviews
The cards render in two columns on desktop and stack morning before evening on mobile without horizontal overflow
Each available bundle adds its four configured products to the cart in one action and refreshes the cart drawer
A bundle with any unavailable product renders a sold-out disabled action and cart errors are announced accessibly
The Add Bundle (10% off) claim matches an active Shopify discount verified in cart and checkout before production release
